title: L1NarrativeExtraction
description: Structured clinical facts extracted from ONE narrative note segment. Every record carries a source_span (char offsets into the segment). Emit null/empty when a field is not present in THIS segment. v2: diagnoses are a list (cancer AND benign urologic dx); grading is cancer-aware (Gleason/GG, Fuhrman, WHO+stage); imaging is separate from procedures (interventions only); treatments link to their diagnosis; the segment is flagged urologic vs non-urologic.

primary_context.description: non_urologic = a tumor-board/consult note whose primary cancer is NOT urologic (lung/colon/etc.). Still extract cross-specialty facts (chemo, radiation, hospitalization, palliative) but do NOT mint a urologic cancer diagnosis from such a note.

diagnoses.description: Every urologic diagnosis in this segment — cancers AND benign conditions (ED, BPH, urolithiasis, renal mass/cyst, hydronephrosis, ...). One entry per distinct diagnosis.

id.description: short stable ref within this segment, e.g. 'dx1' — treatments reference it via for_diagnosis

name.description: e.g. 'prostate adenocarcinoma', 'clear cell RCC', 'urothelial carcinoma', 'erectile dysfunction', 'nephrolithiasis', 'complex left renal cyst'

diagnosis_date.description: ISO; biopsy-confirmed date for cancers, NOT earliest elevated-PSA date

for_diagnosis.description: the diagnoses[].id this treatment targets (e.g. active-surveillance -> the RCC, prostatectomy -> the prostate cancer)

agent.description: specific drug/technique when named (leuprolide, abiraterone, Lu-177 PSMA, IMRT, BCG, ...) — never collapse into modality

end_date.description: populate when a course range is documented so a START date is never rendered as completion

procedures.description: INTERVENTIONS ONLY (biopsy, cystoscopy, TURBT, prostatectomy, ablation, stent, ureteroscopy, nephrectomy ...). NOT imaging (-> imaging[]), NOT labs/cultures/urine studies, NOT exam findings (DRE).

date.description: the PROCEDURE/collection date, NOT the results-notification/sign-out date

imaging.description: Imaging studies (CT, MRI, US, PET, PSMA-PET, bone scan, x-ray, NM) — separate from procedures.

modality.description: CT abdomen/pelvis, prostate MRI, PSMA-PET, bone scan, renal US, ...

grade.description: Cancer-context-aware grade. Set `system` by cancer type and populate only the matching fields.
